Slave labor, taxation of the Outer Rim…''"
"''I didn't come here to end slavery, Bail. I came to eat your food.|Bail and Kayo Organa|audio=Bail-Kayo.flac|}} [[Duke]] '''Kayo Organa''' was a [[human]] [[Gender|male]] member of the [[House of Organa]]. In [[9 BBY]], he and his family—his [[Marriage|wife]] [[Celly Organa|Celly]], son [[Niano Organa|Niano]], and two [[Unidentified Organa child 1|other]] [[Unidentified Organa child 2|children]]—traveled to visit Celly's sister, [[Breha Organa]], and her family, who lived on the [[planet]] [[Alderaan]]. While visiting, Kayo enjoyed the [[Foodstuff|food]] at the [[Royal Palace of Alderaan|Royal Palace]] and conversed with Breha's husband, [[Bail Prestor Organa|Bail]]. ==Biography== {{Quote|After the disaster of the Republic, the Empire is finally starting to line some pockets.|Kayo Organa|audio=Kayo-Pockets.flac|}} [[Duke]] Kayo Organa was a [[human]] [[Gender|male]] of the [[Elder Houses]]' [[House of Organa]]. He was from the [[city]] of [[Hallyn]] on the [[planet]] [[Alderaan]]. Kayo was [[Marriage|married]] to Duchess [[Celly Organa]], sister of [[Queen]] [[Breha Organa]] of [[Alderaan]]. He and Celly had three [[Youngling|children]]: [[Niano Organa|Niano]], and [[Unidentified Organa child 1|two]] [[Unidentified Organa child 1|others]]. The family lived in Hallyn due to the city of [[Aldera]] already having Organas, understanding that the throne would go to a child of Breha's. Though they did not have any official governmental role, Kayo and Celly often visited Aldera to see their family.''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia: The Comprehensive Guide to the Star Wars Galaxy]]'' At some point, Kayo confided in his son that his niece, [[Princess]] [[Leia Skywalker Organa Solo|Leia Organa]], was adopted—and therefore, in his [[eye]]s, not a "real" Organa. He also claimed that her [[parent]]s kept her a secret by keeping her on her [[homeworld]] of Alderaan. In [[9 BBY]],{{KenobiDate|I|the appearance of Kayo Organa}} Kayo and his family visited the family of Celly's sister. Arriving via [[starship]], Kayo, Celly, and Niano greeted Breha's family at a dock and then made their way to the [[Royal Palace of Alderaan]]. [[File:KayoCelly-PartI.png|thumb|left|300px|Kayo and Celly Organa at the Royal Palace of Alderaan]] While at the palace, Kayo talked with Breha and her husband, [[Senator]] [[Bail Prestor Organa|Bail Organa]], regarding pros and cons of the [[Galactic Empire]] versus the [[Galactic Republic]]. Kayo was happy that his profits were good, but Bail was more concerned with [[Slavery|slave]] labor and unjust taxation in the [[Outer Rim Territories]]; Kayo, on the other hand, was more interested in Bail's [[Foodstuff|food]] than slavery. Also at the party, Niano restated the claims that his father had made to Leia, who shot back that Niano only repeated his father's words in an effort to gain his respect even if he did not fully understand them. She further explained that Niano did this out of an attempt to make others scared of him, although in reality, he was really scared of his father and others more. ==Personality and traits== [[File:KayoOrgana-OWKpI.png|thumb|200px|right|Kayo Organa enjoyed the lavish lifestyle afforded him as part of the House of Organa.]] {{Quote|Save the bleeding heart for the Senate.|Kayo Organa to Bail Organa|audio=Kayo-BleedingHeart.flac|}} Kayo Organa was more interested in enjoying the profits that the Empire granted him than discussing the issues of [[the galaxy]], encouraging his senator brother-in-law to save such debate for the [[Imperial Senate]]. Indeed, he and his friends ignored the Empire's labor practices as they benefited from them. Kayo and Celly enjoyed the lavish life of high society, uninterested in politics. He had [[Color|black]] [[hair]], brown eyes, and tan skin. ==Equipment== While on Alderaan, Kayo wore a tan [[Clothing|undertunic]] with a textured orange tunic over it, as well as loose red pants. He wore dark-colored shoes, and his tunic had both a large hood on the back and buttons. ==Behind the scenes== {{Quote|Like so many others, I grew up loving #starwars''[.]''|Gabe Fonseca on portraying Kayo Organa|{{Instagram|username=thegabefonseca|url=p/CeEi5D2JX6L|name=[[Gabe Fonseca]]|quote=Like so many others, I grew up loving #starwars I imagined what it was like to be part of a galaxy far far away.|archiveurl=https://archive.ph/6A6dJ|nolive=1}}}} Kayo Organa appeared in "[[Part I]]," the first episode of the live-action series ''[[Star Wars: Obi-Wan Kenobi]]'', which premiered on [[May 26]], [[2022]].{{Twitter|obiwankenobi|status/1530019678562549760|''[[Star Wars: Obi-Wan Kenobi]]''|date=2022-05-27|quote=The time for #ObiWanKenobi has arrived…early. Start streaming the first two episodes on @DisneyPlus TONIGHT at 9PM PT.|archivedate=20220527053945}} In the episode, he was portrayed by [[Gabe Fonseca]], and his name was revealed in the credits. After having grown up with ''[[Star Wars]]'', Fonseca was very thankful to casting director [[Carmen Cuba]] for the opportunity to act in ''Obi-Wan Kenobi'' and wear costumes by costume designer [[Suttirat Anne Larlarb]], work with director [[Deborah Chow]], and work with Bail Organa actor [[Jimmy Smits]]. He also noted that he learned a lot from the experience and considered himself lucky for it. ==Appearances== {{Mediacat|imagecat=Images of Kayo Organa|soundcat=Audio files of Kayo Organa}} *{{Kenobi|Part I}} {{1st}} *[[Obi-Wan Kenobi 1|''Obi-Wan Kenobi'' 1]] ==Sources== *{{Topps|set=2023 Topps Star Wars: Obi-Wan Kenobi|cardname=Kayo Organa|link=https://www.tcdb.com/ViewCard.cfm/sid/363350/cid/21461400/2023}} *{{SW|url=news/sdcc-2023-lucasfilm-publishing-panel|text=SDCC 2023: 10 Reveals from the Lucasfilm Publishing Panel}} *''[[Star Wars: Dawn of Rebellion: The Visual Guide]]'' *{{SW|url=news/dawn-of-rebellion|text=5 Behind-the-Pages Secrets of ''Star Wars:'' ''Dawn of Rebellion''}} *''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia: The Comprehensive Guide to the Star Wars Galaxy]]'' *{{Topps|set=2025 Topps Chrome Star Wars|cardname=#127 - Kayo Organa|link=https://www.ebay.com/itm/257133756382}} ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |de=Kayo Organa |es=Kayo Organa |fr=Kayo Organa |ja=カヨ・オーガナ |ka=კაიო ორგანა |nl=Kayo Organa |pl=Kayo Organa |pt=Kayo Organa |tr=Kayo Organa }} {{DEFAULTSORT: Organa, Kayo}} [[Category:Dukes]] [[Category:House of Organa]] [[Category:Humans]] [[Category:Individuals with he/him pronouns]] [[Category:Males]]
